sigma_actual_over_ambient_at_exit.note: the old multiplier was 1.10; the residual volatility at the exit ran above it three times in three

error_of_old_point_estimates_usd_per_fly.note: all three too optimistic: one price was used for the stock, and a short fly loses on any move from that price

methods.A: model: report move drawn from a fat-tailed distribution (expected size = half the name's own history, half what names like it realise against the options), fly priced at the exit with ambient volatility x sigma_multiplier, less slippage
methods.B: replay average for this entry day: 12.5% of the entry straddle kept when three days are left at the exit, less slippage
methods.C: the earlier point estimate: six past moves at 1.1x ambient volatility

scoring: At each exit record, per name: actual P/L after fees; error against A, B and C; whether it fell inside A's 50% and 80% bands; |move| / expected_abs_move; implied sigma at the exit read / ambient sigma; fill against mid. Append one scoreboard row per name.
update_rules: sigma_multiplier = the mean of sigma_actual_over_ambient_at_exit over the last 10 exits (all of them until there are 10)
slippage_usd_per_fly = the mean of actual fill-against-mid by kind of chain over the last 10 exits of that kind
after 10 scored names: keep the method with the smallest mean absolute error as the point estimate, and re-fit blend_weight_history to the realised moves
after 10 scored names: if fewer than 6 of 10 fell inside the 80% band, lower t_dof to 3; if all 10 did, raise it to 6
a constant never changes by more than 20% in one update, and every change is logged here with the evidence
